note: Every rate here was read on 2026-10-14 from the provider's own pricing page (the `sourceUrl` on each model); no figure is carried over from memory or from a price-comparison aggregator. Rows priced in tiers record the base tier and name the tier in `note` — length tiers, time-of-day rates and announced step-ups are not modeled (issue #105). `cacheWritePer1M` is Anthropic's 5-minute-TTL write; its 1-hour writes cost 2x base input, and the other providers do not bill cache writes separately. Context windows come from each vendor's model page rather than its pricing page (OpenAI developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/*, Google ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/*, Anthropic platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview, Mistral docs.mistral.ai/models/*); for open-weight models served by Together, Fireworks and DeepInfra the window is `max_position_embeddings` from the model's own config.json on Hugging Face. API prices move every few weeks and whole model families turn over in months — re-verify against the source URLs before trusting any figure, and treat anything older than a quarter as stale.
